author: root Codex personal mechanism design, symbolic proof and critical-source acceptance
status: design contract and finite hand proof; no new model, RTL or experiment

positive_rule.commit: Before first physical child AWVALID, freeze L <= r + D, with r>0 true contiguous resident words assigned exclusively to that child. Initial D=Q=3; the logical parent length is never offered as an upstream physical AW.
positive_rule.escape: On real source starvation, if an independently authorized fully resident peer child is eligible, finish the current physical burst using zero strobes without consuming source data or advancing logical true-write progress. Settle its actual B, then resume exactly the still-unwritten range using the retained parent permission. A resumed patch must advance at least one real W before another conversion.
positive_rule.two_obligations: Track current physical true-W debt separately from the unreceived length of every accepted source AR. D bounds only the former. The latter requires complete destination permission coverage and explicit return-buffer admission.
positive_rule.contribution_target: Trade a bounded amount of recoverable missing data for fewer physical write requests under small payload storage, while preserving successful logical completion and independent peer service. Generic priority, parent splitting, zero strobes, pretranslation and B merging are components, not separately new claims.

root_symbolic_capability_proof.givens: An already accepted online state: A has exactly three usable payload slots, B occupies its three slots until its fixed release at t30; neither may change this preaccepted history. A copy is N=12 words. The normal history in the B card finishes A at t18, before B releases storage. Same physical read/write rates, preparation and metadata are granted to both methods.
root_symbolic_capability_proof.resident_only_lower_bound: Before t30, a physical A AW committed only when its entire payload is resident has length at most3. Therefore completing all12 true words before t30 requires at least ceil(12/3)=4 A AW, regardless of timer, ready-prefix selector, advance translation, future knowledge or fragment-size adaptation. A second AW with only three resident words cannot contain the remaining nine under this contract.
root_symbolic_capability_proof.candidate_point: L=r+3 permits two six-word A children while retaining only three actual A words at a time; the provided continuous-source hand history uses two A AW and completes at t18. At a later starvation head, all initial r words must have been truly written; true debt q<=L-r<=3. Both properties hold under one future-blind rule.
root_symbolic_capability_proof.recursive_bound: Every later resumed child must make real progress before reconversion. Its q strictly falls. Per original physical child, at most D conversions, at most D(D+1)/2 null beats and at most1+D physical AW including the original. These are service/count bounds, not elapsed-time bounds, and are summed over all children of a long job.
root_symbolic_capability_proof.ordinary_streaming_counterpart: An ordinary long streaming AW can match or exceed the normal request count, but after only its first three true words it can owe nine physical words. To reproduce the q<=3 capability throughout arbitrary source gaps it must limit its nonresident commitment or add a different release capability. An ordinary successful-replay implementation using the same debt cap is an exact algorithmic counterpart, so this proof does not establish novelty over all combinations of existing primitives.
root_symbolic_capability_proof.stronger_adaptive_counterexample: The B acceptance followup constructed one future-blind ordinary streaming policy matching both selected continuations: start with resident3; after no observed long gap, stream the remaining9 (normal A17/2AW versus candidate A18/2AW); after an observed long gap, use3 then6 (gap A114/B11/C108/3AAW/0null versus candidate A114/B13/C108/3AAW/3null). Therefore the two scene timings are not evidence of an unreplicated performance point. The resident-only lower bound remains valid only for that narrower action class.
root_symbolic_capability_proof.root_next_opposite_branch: Keep the normal prefix through an irrevocable second AW of the adaptive counterpart, then delay future source words and release a fully resident authorized peer. That second AW covers9 words while at most3 are resident, so a source stop after consuming all resident words may leave at least6 true-W debt. The bounded-debt rule has at most3 at every such child. This is an adversarial capability check under unknown future, not a new measured latency or whole-job dominance result.
root_symbolic_capability_proof.opposite_branch_hand_result: B completed the exact finite branch: A0..5 eligible0..5, later six words eligible100..105, peerB eligible10. Adaptive ordinary: second AW9 at7, true3/4/5 at8/9/10, then q6, A107/B110. Candidate: initial AW6 true LAST9/B10, peerB W11..13/ACK14; A later child AW6 at103, W104..109/ACK110. Both total3 physical AW/B, realR/W15, sourceAR2, null0. Root checked event ordering and resource use directly. This is a three-unit A delay for a96-unit B advance in this abstract hand history, not a benchmark, an optimal-policy result or proof of independent innovation.
root_symbolic_capability_proof.scope_limit: The lower bound is conditional on the preaccepted occupancy and completion deadline. If source admission is redesigned before this history, more A storage is available, or ordinary controls may borrow occupied B storage, the bound does not apply. This is not a global optimality theorem or a measured platform speedup.

minimal_architecture_contract.initial_geometry: Aligned, stable Normal DDR copy; no overlapping destinations, MMIO, exclusive or atomic access. Each accepted source AR stays within a source page and all destination children are covered by prepared WRITE regions. The first focused case uses one destination4KiB page; later multi-page cases must pay for additional records or split AR before firstVALID.
minimal_architecture_contract.prepare: Add a native nonclaiming preparation request with the normal untranslated READ or WRITE semantics, DID/PID/privilege and request origin. It must arbitrate into actual TL translation and permission checks without presenting AW to any shared W-owner mux. Serialize preparation initially. A response-origin tag and matching handshake are required; bank alone is not an adequate prepare-vs-normal discriminator.
minimal_architecture_contract.permission_record: Bind successful source READ and complete destination WRITE PA/range to the original flow, parent and access attributes. Reject faults, ignored/MRIF results and incompatible paths. Cover every destination byte required to consume the entire accepted source return. Same PA alone cannot authorize another flow. Keep destination authorization through all true writes and all physical B responses; keep source completion independently through actual RLAST.
minimal_architecture_contract.return_admission: Exactly one non-full-buffer source stream may have a priming lease. Other accepted source bursts require their complete return capacity reserved. The priming lease lasts through the envelope's final actual true WLAST across all children and patches; it is not released by a null LAST or by the first child LAST. Old B and permission records survive that release. A full-resident peer may run while the primer is temporarily escaped.
minimal_architecture_contract.child_boundary: Generate child descriptors before the first shared DMA AW mux. All later W-owner FIFOs must observe the actual child or repair lengths and LAST. Changing only the downstream IOMMU/MIG LAST leaves the original upstream owner locked and does not implement this contract.
minimal_architecture_contract.physical_authorization_path: A prepared reference must be checked against the retained range and operation identity at a trusted physical child/repair path. The current normal virtual-AW path will translate again; simply setting an ATS/translated flag does not provide a free physical authorization bypass. The physical routing, AXI ID namespace, response demultiplexing and arbitration are explicit added integration work for both candidate and ordinary controls.
minimal_architecture_contract.state_lifetime: Do not reuse the child/repair descriptor until its physical B is accepted and merged. Null W never pops true source FIFO data, never marks logical bytes written, and never returns a successful user B. Held AWVALID/WVALID payload and same-ID ordering stay immutable. Only all true bytes plus settled physical responses permit one final logical successful completion.
minimal_architecture_contract.revocation: Stable mappings are an explicit first contract. A generation counter alone is insufficient for invalidation or wrap. Dynamic mapping changes need stop-new-use, drain/revoke and command-completion integration. Permission retention and IOFENCE semantics cannot be inferred from a cache-valid bit.
minimal_architecture_contract.complete_control: Give published CutForward, adaptive resident-prefix and ordinary success-replay the same preparation record, PA derivation, source policy, payload pool and metadata budget. Include every job's ACK, all AW/B, AR/R, useful and null W, preparation latency, added control state, ports and timing cuts.

actual_source_gate.fact: Current translation request has IOVA/DID/PID/type/privilege/debug/bank and response has PA/range/permission/error. There is no native prepared-parent origin or lease completion port.

Normal/debug/ATS inputs arbitrate into a shared request spill and responses retire through their corresponding handshake. A new origin must survive this whole path; stealing the debug or ATS mode changes semantics.
Current read admission uses immutable W ownership. It cannot be removed without the replacement return-capacity/primer invariant.
Current WRITE prep begins from an ordinary AW and is selected ahead of READ. It does not implement nonclaiming parent preparation.
The four-DMA shared AW/W mux precedes IOMMU translation. Existing parent-length AW cannot be left here while downstream children are patched.
First downstream AW offer acquires W ownership before AWREADY; only actual WLAST releases it.

additional_primary_review.title: Arm AMBA LTI Protocol Specification, IHI0089 IssueE, March2026
additional_primary_review.root_direct_read: B1.1/B1.2, B4.1 order-group rules, B6.2 completion and translation reuse
additional_primary_review.implication: Translation before transaction ordering, lookaside data routing, reuse of a validated region for compatible transactions, and completion after all uses are already specified. These generic capabilities are strong ordinary components. The passages do not by themselves establish the bounded nonresident-debt successful continuation rule.
additional_primary_review.deadlock_lifetime_limit: B6.2 constrains translation completion dependencies and recommends bounded concurrent reuse; prolonged retention can delay CPU invalidation barriers. The proposed retained envelope cannot be called cost-free caching.

next_decisive_work.one_question: With actual source admission and the pre-mux boundary, what is the smallest complete implementation of a uniform missing-data debt cap with successful continuation, and which exact successful-replay prior work already implements it?
next_decisive_work.method: Complete a concrete prepare-origin/response/permission/child-routing state sketch and a same-budget ordinary sketch first. Use a surprise gap after immutable AW length as the opposing continuation to normal streaming; the original two selected timings are matched by one stronger adaptive control. Reuse the existing event checker only after the interface and capability contracts close; do not expand to a new large matrix or production BIT yet.
next_decisive_work.mainline_causal_gate: Preparation/range retention and generic W scheduling must be separated. Include an actual other-DMA cold translation sharing DDR service, and count its walk/return stall under the same complete preparation resources. If improvement exists only for injected source gaps with all translations preprepared and no translation feedback, it is a general AXI scheduling result, not demonstrated shared-IOMMU translation-interference contribution.
next_decisive_work.accept_if: If the additional normal-operation debt cap plus retained permission/replay provides an unreplicated complete resource/capability point at material implementation cost on this platform, advance one focused RTL experiment. If exact prior implementation has the same point, use reproduction to locate its limitation and redesign that limitation.
next_decisive_work.current_decision: Advance bounded-debt capability design and primary implementation comparison; use C paired preparation as a common component. No performance, publication tier or first-publication claim is accepted.
